regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Telluride leads with 20" over the window, 15" of it Sunday. A Winter Storm Warning runs Sunday into Monday, and rain and snow mix in Sunday before turning to snow Monday. Crested Butte gets 8" and Vail 6". Winds gust to 30 mph Monday night.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Snowbird and Alta each project 10" through Wednesday, 4" of it Sunday. Alta has an NWS forecast raised to 21" over Sunday through Tuesday night, and a Winter Weather Advisory covers Saturday night into Monday. Brighton totals 9". Snow is light and steady Monday.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler projects 9" through Thursday, with 6" on Thursday itself. Environment Canada calls for a mix of sun and cloud through Thursday daytime, then a 60 percent chance of showers Thursday night. Cypress Mountain sees 5" Thursday, with periods of rain that night.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Taos projects 7", 6" of it Sunday, with rain showers turning to rain and snow Sunday night. Winds gust to 40 mph Sunday night. Wolf Creek has 7" and an NWS forecast raised to 14" over Sunday through Wednesday, under a Winter Storm Warning from Sunday night into Monday with gusts to 45 mph.

ahead.text: The Weather Prediction Center expects a slowly moving storm to bring heavy rain across the central and eastern US around Monday Nov 9 to Friday Nov 13. Confidence in its timing and strength is low.
